thesis: The podcast explores the historical connection between the 1960s counterculture, specifically the communes and the Whole Earth Catalog, and the founding ethos of Silicon Valley. It argues that the spirit of the communes did not die but was replicated in technology, influencing concepts like the personal computer and video games as tools of personal liberation.
